description: Contractual benefit in kind such as housing, a car or employer-paid tax, paid at the agreed value when the contract sets an amount; taxable employment income.

references.title: Revenue Code ss.39, 40(1)
references.quote: Income from employment includes money's worth and other benefits the employer provides, including housing, a car and income tax the employer bears.

description: Contractual fixed monthly allowance paid when the contract sets an amount. Prorated by the calendar days of the salary coverage over the days of its month, then by the paid share (unpaid leave and absence reduce it as they reduce salary). A wage that enters the social-security and workmen's compensation bases.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.5; Social Security Act B.E. 2533 (1990) s.5
references.quote: A fixed monthly allowance paid for normal working time is wage and enters the SSO and WCF bases; it is employment income under Revenue Code s.40(1).
